propositions: fsck and compact-all scans visit every ticket directory (O(all tickets)), including archived tickets that are excluded from default list operations, making routine health checks slower as the store grows
leaf.archive() must perform terminal fold inline (threshold=0, horizon=0) before writing the ARCHIVED event to ensure archived tickets carry no unfolded events
fsck and compact-all must default to active-only scanning (skipping archived dirs via .archived marker + _is_net_archived confirmation) with --include-archived override to visit all tickets
A ticket with a stale .archived marker but no net-archived state (reverted archive) must not be skipped by active-only default scoping

Terminal fold at archive time makes the default compact-all walk complete for just-archived tickets; --include-archived sweep provides belt-and-suspenders folding for legacy archived-but-unfolded tickets from pre-change builds
